Definition: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
BiblicalUsage: prep; 1) as far as, even to, until, up to, while, as far as; 1a) of space; 1a1) as far as, up to, even to; 1b) in combination; 1b1) from...as far as, both...and (with 'min' -from); 1c) of time; 1c1) even to, until, unto, till, during, end; 1d) of degree; 1d1) even to, to the degree of, even like; conj; 2) until, while, to the point that, so that even
